adjudicated.jp: 屋上に来てみた。
adjudicated.en: I tried going to the rooftop.
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: 時刻は１０時をまわっている。
adjudicated.en: Present time is past 10AM.
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: どうせ……授業があるわけでもない。
adjudicated.en: After all... we have no classes in this situation.
comments: Perfectly applicable if at least he is in Class X... perhaps everybody, given he's running around like nobody's business even in the flashbacks. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: ただ学校空間に触れたかっただけだ。
adjudicated.en: I only wanted to come into contact with the space of the school itself.
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: なんてことのない日常を、味わいたかっただけ。
adjudicated.en: Just to taste the quiet normal unruffled daily life.
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: 精神安定剤のように―――
adjudicated.en: Like an ataractic---
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: 屋上には誰もいない……。
adjudicated.en: There is no one on the rooftop...
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.en: Taichi: "Hm?"
adjudicated.assessment: The source text has multiple authoritative occurrences and this unit lacks a unique binding.

adjudicated.jp: でもなかった。
adjudicated.en: I mean there wasn't.
adjudicated.assessment: The Japanese negates the preceding claim that nobody was present; the English repeats that claim instead of reversing it.

adjudicated.jp: 部活……ってやつか。
adjudicated.en: Club... that's what she's here for.
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: アンテナを見あげる。
adjudicated.en: I look up at the antenna.
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: 世界から人が消えて。
adjudicated.en: People have vanished from the world.
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: 俺たちは結束することもできず、個人だった。
adjudicated.en: And we were individuals, unable to stand in unity.
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: 結束していたとしても無力さに変わりはないだろうけど。
adjudicated.en: Though I believe this powerlessness would not change even if there had been unity.
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: ……個々の問題ともなればこのヘビィな状況は、心を軋ませた。
adjudicated.en: ...with these individual problems, this heavy situation would make any heart creak.
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.en: Taichi: "......"
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: 直射日光、危ないかな。
adjudicated.en: Won't direct sunlight exposure be dangerous?
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: そばに目覚まし時計が転がっていた。
adjudicated.en: An alarm clock was casually dropped nearby.
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: 先輩の私物だろうか。

adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: アラームを五分後にセットする。
adjudicated.en: I set the alarm for five minutes from now.
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: これで起きてくれるだろう。
adjudicated.en: This should wake her up,

adjudicated.jp: みみ先輩に寝ぼすけ属性はないのだ。
adjudicated.en: because Mimi-senpai does not have the Sleepyhead Character Attribute.
comments: See CCC4019, CCD1001. She doesn't have it as Character Attribute, but that doesn't mean she doesn't oversleep. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.en: Taichi: "Hm?"

adjudicated.jp: 一箇所、金網が脆くなっていた。
adjudicated.en: In one place, that one place, the wire mesh had become fragile.
comments: Same where most people fall down including Yutaka, so he knows that place very well. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: 軽く押すと、めきめきと倒れていく。

adjudicated.jp: 「危ねー」

adjudicated.jp: 夢幻に生きる者の多い群青では、大変な管理問題だぞ。

adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.en: Taichi: "..."
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: ま、今のメンバーなら平気か。
adjudicated.en: Well, with our members we should be alright.

adjudicated.jp: 全員、日常生活に支障はないはずだ。
adjudicated.en: None of our members had impediments to our normal daily life.

adjudicated.jp: ゆっくりと階段に向かう。
adjudicated.en: Slowly I head towards the stairs.

adjudicated.jp: 背後から目覚ましのアラームと、

adjudicated.jp: 「んあっ？」
